meta.name: muapi-ugc-ads-workflow
meta.description: Create a User-Generated Content (UGC) video ad by combining a human selfie and a product image, then generating a video script and an animated ad.

copy.tagline: 将自拍和产品图合成 UGC 视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作真人出镜的产品推广视频
copy.tagline_en: Combine selfie and product image into UGC video ads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create product promo videos with real people

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你制作 UGC 视频广告：先合成一张人物手持产品的照片，再生成带时间戳的脚本和动画视频。
howto.when: 当你提到“ugc ad”、“ugc video”、“influencer ad”等关键词，或要求制作产品广告视频时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 UGC 广告视频，产品是 Blume SuperBalm。
say.note: Claude 会要求你上传人物和产品照片。

say.text: 用这张自拍和产品图合成一个广告视频。
say.note: Claude 会先合成照片，再生成脚本和视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you create a UGC video ad: first combine a human selfie and a product image, then generate a timestamped script and an animated video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "ugc ad", "ugc video", "influencer ad", or ask to create a product ad video.

say_en.text: Create a UGC ad video for Blume SuperBalm.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for your selfie and product photo.

say_en.text: Combine this selfie and product image into an ad video.
say_en.note: Claude will first merge the images, then generate script and video.
